question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: But he always replied only with a superior smile when asked by reporters to put the philsophy and the tripel ethic into words.
But he always replied only with a supereor smile when asked by reporters to put the philosophy and the triple ethic into words.
But he always replied only with a superior smile when asked by reporters to put the philosophy and the triple ethic into words.
But he always replied only with a superior smile when asked by reporters to put the philusophy and the triple ethic into words.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"philosophy"** means the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence. (दर्शनशास्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **He studied philosophy at the university to better understand the nature of human existence.
 
 
 
• **"Triple" **refers to something that is three times as much or as many. (तीन गुना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company achieved triple the sales compared to last year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "But he always replied only with a superior smile when asked by reporters to put the philsophy and the tripel ethic into words."

 
 
• **Philsophy (incorrect):** Misspelling of "philosophy". (फिलॉसफी)
 
• **Tripel (incorrect):** Misspelling of "triple". (ट्रिपल)
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "But he always replied only with a supereor smile when asked by reporters to put the philosophy and the triple ethic into words."
 
 
• **Supereor (incorrect):** Misspelling of "superior". (श्रेष्ठ)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "But he always replied only with a superior smile when asked by reporters to put the philusophy and the triple ethic into words."
 
 
• **Philusophy (incorrect):** Misspelling of "philosophy". (फिलॉसफी)
